sources.title: Next-generation file formats (NGFF), version 0.4 (Final Community Group Report, 1 October 2026)

pin.locator: Sections 2.1 (Zarr v2 hierarchy, nested chunk layout), 3.1 ("axes" metadata: name MUST; type/unit SHOULD, UDUNITS-2), 3.3 ("coordinateTransformations": identity/translation/scale, applied sequentially in order), 3.4 ("multiscales": 2-5 dims; axes ordered time, channel/custom, space; datasets ordered largest->smallest; exactly one scale per dataset; translation after scale; version history table), 3.5 ("omero": channel window min/max/start/end; rdefs defaultZ/defaultT), 3.6-3.7 (labels/image-label), 5 (implementations list incl. bioformats2raw, ome-zarr-py, vizarr, bigdataviewer-ome-zarr), 7 (version history: 0.3.0 added axes field; 0.4.0 2022-02-08 'multiscales: add axes type, units and coordinateTransformations'; 0.4.1 bioformats2raw.layout)

sources.applicability: Primary normative contract for the project's image metadata model (axes/units/scale/translation/channel windows) and for OME-Zarr as derived-data/exchange format. Community-group report, not a formal standard; MUST/SHOULD language per RFC 2119.

sources.title: RFC 7946: The GeoJSON Format

pin.locator: Abstract (WGS84, decimal degrees); Section 3.1.1 Position ('first two elements are longitude and latitude, or easting and northing, precisely in that order'); 3.1.6 Polygon winding (right-hand rule, exterior counterclockwise); 3.1.10 Uncertainty and Precision; Section 4 Coordinate Reference System (alternative CRS 'removed from this version ... proven to have interoperability issues'; allowed 'where all involved parties have a prior arrangement'); Section 6.1 Foreign Members (allowed, no normative processing model, reduced interoperability risk)

sources.applicability: Basis for the GeoJSON export honesty contract: micrometer coordinates are non-conformant absent an explicit prior arrangement, carried as foreign members; winding normalization; precision statement.
